title: Transient widget startup reads recover without replaying messages, authentication or site operations
steps: Run the deterministic Hono and browser-script bootstrap suites; no real provider, microphone or site operations.
expect: Temporary DNS, connection and database readiness failures return sanitized HTTP503 retryable true; unknown or unreadable context returns retryable false.
Only state and catalogue GET reads may retry twice, with a ten-second timeout per attempt; POST adoption, message, authentication and creation requests are not automatically retried.
Exhaustion provides an explicit single-flight retry action without clearing saved state, drafts or visitor cookies.
Unreadable saved context is refused without cookie replacement or store writes; diagnostics contain fixed categories only.
fence: Read-only retry allowlist, bounded attempts/timeouts, server retry hints and existing owner/context fences.

tests: only transient bootstrap GET reads retry twice and retain draft/history while connecting
network GET failure retries but native adoption POST failure is not automatically retried
an unreadable saved visitor is refused without replacing its cookie or overwriting its context
